title: Complex components
scope: raw horizontally scrollable civic data tables

resolvedFindings.change: Table/List controls now use type=button, aria-pressed and 44px minimum height; decorative icons are hidden from assistive technology.
The user-facing debug dump was removed and replaced with a concise list-view-unavailable status.
TableWithToggle plus 14 raw dense tables in Statistics, Projects & Budget, Elections and Integrity now use named, focusable scroll regions.
Shared scroll-region CSS provides visible keyboard focus, contained horizontal overscroll and stable scrollbar space.
Interactive links/buttons inside scroll-region tables inherit a 44px minimum target.
PhotoCarousel selector dots are now 44x44 and expose aria-pressed in addition to current-slide state.
Photo fallback, credit and license links meet the 44px interaction-height baseline.
Featured Reports desktop/mobile View all links now meet the 44px interaction-height baseline.
The Start here homepage barangay selector now uses the 44px baseline.
Civic map full-map handoff and CivicAreaContextMap station/context links are touch sized.
Heritage map place markers expose a 44px link target while preserving the smaller visual pin.
Filtered Calendar timeline counts now have a polite live status without changing the visible heading.
Office, budget-line and procurement search/filter controls tied to dense tables use the 44px baseline, with result counts announced.

intentionalHorizontalScroll.treatment: Scroller itself is not an extra Tab stop because every chip is a 44px focusable button and focused controls can scroll into view.
Scroller retains focusable child controls rather than adding a redundant focusable container.
Scroller retains 44px focusable child controls and becomes wrapped/overflow-visible from sm upward.

mapAccessibility.civicAreaContext: Interactive OSM iframe has a title; layer buttons expose aria-pressed; textual area/mobility links remain below the map.
mapAccessibility.civicMapEmbed: Interactive iframe has a title and a 44px external full-map fallback.
mapAccessibility.heritageMap: Background iframe is deliberately pointer-disabled and aria-hidden; canonical place links are the accessible interactive map layer.

carouselAccessibility.photoCarousel: Previous/next, selector and play/pause controls are >=44px; user interaction pauses rotation; reduced-motion disables rotation; manually changed slides announce their index.
carouselAccessibility.featuredReports: Previous/next and pause/resume controls are >=44px and use the shared reduced-motion/focus-aware carousel hook.

bounded.reason: Only a real 320/390/768 viewport can prove which regions overflow and whether focus scrolling feels usable.
External OSM iframe keyboard behavior and browser focus transfer need runtime testing.
Actual pause-on-focus/hover and reduced-motion behavior must be sampled in a browser.
Source semantics do not replace manual table/list and map announcement sampling.
